subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

The brothers __defended__ their sister every time.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Defended: English meaning – to protect from harm or attack; Hindi meaning – बचाव करना (Bachav Karna)
 
• Example: The soldiers defended their country bravely during the war.
 
• Protected: English meaning – kept safe from harm or injury; Hindi meaning – सुरक्षा करना (Suraksha Karna)
 
• Example: The mother protected her child from the stray dog.

Therefore, the correct answer is- protected

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Invaded – English meaning: to enter forcefully; Hindi meaning – घुसपैठ करना (Ghuspaith Karna)
 
• **Option 2:** Condemned – English meaning: to express disapproval; Hindi meaning – निंदा करना (Ninda Karna)
 
• **Option 3:** United – English meaning: joined together; Hindi meaning – एकजुट होना (Ekjut Hona)

30:T57e,

The correct answer is **option 3.**
